burst: the swap beam (22.2%) and the 11.9% rider are both gated by the kit on "when Hero Vision is at max stacks", and the model assumes that gate is OPEN for the whole 10s window. OWNER RULING 2026-08-12 fixes the mechanism: Hero Vision stacks come ONLY from Full Charge attacks, and her burst weapon does not charge — so she gains ZERO stacks during the window and enters it with whatever she built. She does NOT lose them either: stacks REFRESH as a whole set on each new stack (game-wide rule, owner ruling 2026-08-11 = docs/modeling-priors.md prior 12; the engine already conforms — applyBuff resets expiresFrame on every re-application and maxStacks caps the count), so the 15s clock is reset by her last pre-burst full-charge shot and outlasts the 10s window. The gate therefore holds for the WHOLE window once it is open, and the over-credit is narrow: a burst cast BEFORE she has landed 5 full-charge shots, which at 1.37s/shot (60f charge + 22f bolt recovery) is realistically the fight's FIRST burst. ENACTED with the EXISTING resource primitives, no new engine gate: a heroVision pool (initial 0, max 5), +1 per base full-charge pull (skill1 shotFired + swapGate 'unswapped' — the beam does not charge, so it grants none), read by resourceGate on both clauses. The beam splits into two mutually-exclusive burstCast branches, resourceGate min 5 (trueNormals, true-flavored) and max 4 (identical but plain), so a below-max cast still fires the beam as normal damage exactly as the kit says; the 11.9% rider carries resourceGate min 5 alongside its swapGate. Worth -1.00% on her total in the 720-kit-audit control comp (liter B1 / crown B2 / laplace B3 carry+focus / helm B3, boss Fire), where her three teammates are byte-identical because both gated clauses are self-scoped (the beam's own flavor and her own 11.9% rider) and neither feeds an ally bucket. APPROXIMATION, deliberate: a resource does not expire, so the pool is monotone — which matches the whole-set refresh rule at scope lock (she fires continuously, so the 15s clock never lapses) and diverges only across a >15s firing pause, which the continuous scope-lock fight does not contain.
